title: On The Fourth of July It Is Good To Be Reminded That The Only Doctor Who Signed The Declaration of Independence Warned Us

content_html_sanitized:
In 1776, modern science was still in its infancy. Benjamin Franklin, one of the signers of the Declaration of Independence, was world famous because he had discovered that lightning was electricity.

 

Medical science was in its infancy, and doctors were often a menace more than a help. Thirty three years later, in 1799, George Washington, the first President and the richest man in the country, would be bled to death because “medical science” said that it was the appropriate treatment.

 

Benjamin Rush, who was the only signer of the Declaration of Independence who was a doctor, actually warned us, " Unless we put medical freedom into the Constitution, the time will come when medicine will organize into an undercover dictatorship to restrict the art of healing to one class of men and deny equal privileges to others: The Constitution of this Republic should make a special privilege for medical freedom as well as religious freedom. "

 

Medical science has advanced enormously since then. Even in my lifetime (b. 1940) there has been great progress. For example, most doctors have stopped smoking cigarettes. Psychiatry has split into multiple theories, while claiming legal authority (so who’s crazy now?), and the Department of Health and Human Services is being run by a person with no medical background.

 

We have arrested over thirty million Americans for just possessing a plant with no lethal dose, after banning and then legalizing a drug that has killed millions. We developed the largest prison system in the world, and ignored its public health implications. And, wow, we are morbidly obese!

 

As I have tried to explain, when I first got involved in the “marijuana reform movement” I was completely unaware of its medical use, and I have been amazed by how threatened authorities are by people refusing to suffer and die.

 

From June 22, 2001 A Very Revealing Week for Medical Marijuana. A Series of Events that We Couldn't Make Up.

 

And from June 25, 2025 Questions About Addictions and Mental Illness. Confusing Cause and Effect.

 

The more things change…
